I once heard at a conference talk: 

> **'The next big disaster is going to be a software disaster'** 

By disasters we usually think of earhquakes, tornados and other big forces of nature. The intention behind the statement was to make us understand how much code is running in our day-to-day lives and the **responsibility** that coders have to embrace.
